data.action: 双手捧大拉面碗鼓起腮帮吹热气，嘴咬溏心蛋被撞见双耳竖立，满脸通红强行掩饰
data.camera: medium shot, counter seating perspective, focus on puffed cheeks, steam, and blushing fox ears
data.description: 【星见雅 · 巷角拉面摊吸溜骨汤的腮帮鼓鼓】新艾利都老街深处热气腾腾的深夜拉面摊前，暖帘随夜风轻扬。换上一身素雅巫女服常服的雅坐在木质高脚吧台凳上，两只小手捧着比脸还大的青花瓷大碗。平日威风凛凛的武士彻底放下了所有架子，两颊腮帮子鼓鼓地塞满了劲道拉面，正认真地嘟起粉唇吹着碗里冒着热气的浓白豚骨汤。被突然拉开帘子坐在身旁的你撞见后，她猝不及防地呛了一下，双狐耳猛地竖起，雪白蓬松的狐尾在凳边竖成一团。嘴里还咬着半截溏心蛋，她急忙咽下去，耳根通红地强行掩饰——「……唔！及时的热量补充也是课长重要勤务……绝对不准笑话我！」
data.lighting: 拉面摊暖黄吊灯洒在浓郁骨汤热气、青花大碗与白皙腮帮上的治愈烟火气光影
data.location: 老街暖光拉面摊木质吧台前
data.promptProse: A heart-meltingly charming slice-of-life anime illustration of Hoshimi Miyabi from Zenless Zone Zero sitting at a cozy, steaming street-side ramen stall counter at night. Dressed in her comfortable shrine robes with her sword resting safely behind her, she holds a large ceramic bowl of steaming tonkotsu ramen with both hands, her cheeks adorable and puffed out as she blows gently on hot noodles. Caught off guard by her partner sitting down beside her, her pointy white fox ears shoot straight up in sudden fluster and her fluffy tail curls tightly around the stool. With a soft blush heating her porcelain face and her golden eyes wide with embarrassment, she quickly swallows to explain herself. Warm glow diffusing through delicious rising steam, cozy midnight atmosphere, clean anime linework, no text.
data.title: 星见雅 · 巷角拉面摊吸溜骨汤的腮帮鼓鼓
